title: Single Grain Alternatives for Paid Ads Across Meta and Search
summary: Single Grain alternatives for paid ads: Knowlify for Meta video creative, then multichannel agencies compared on published scope, fees and fit, October 2026.
body_markdown:
## Which agencies cover search and social together?


[Darkroom's paid media page](https://darkroomagency.com/services/paid-media) describes ideal clients as mid-market and enterprise consumer brands, typically with $10M to $500M in revenue, selling across several channels. It says the fit is poor for single-channel brands and companies under roughly $5M. Its programs cover Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, Amazon, Walmart and Instacart, with pricing from $1,500 a month as a retainer plus a percentage of media.


[KlientBoost's services page](https://www.klientboost.com/services/) groups its work into paid advertising (PPC, Facebook ads, Google ads, SEM and LinkedIn ads), SEO, conversion rate optimization and email marketing. Its[Facebook ads page](https://www.klientboost.com/services/facebook-ads-agency/) lists ad budgets from $5,000 a month and five ways to work together, from ongoing management to a one-time audit or setup.


[Disruptive Advertising's services page](https://disruptiveadvertising.com/digital-marketing-services/) lists paid advertising on Google, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, X and other networks, plus landing pages, creative strategy and email. Its[social advertising page](https://disruptiveadvertising.com/social-media-advertising/) describes a free audit, a strategy tier priced at "a couple thousand dollars" and a Done For You tier. Its homepage mentions a 90-day guarantee for qualifying brands without defining them, so get the conditions in writing.


[MuteSix's homepage](https://mutesix.com/) describes an omnichannel approach with paid social on Instagram, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Pinterest, alongside paid search, retail media, programmatic and lifecycle marketing. Its[Facebook ads page](https://mutesix.com/services/facebook-ad-agency/) describes creative from an in-house studio. It does not publish pricing or minimums. Our[best performance marketing agencies](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-performance-marketing-agencies-meta) guide compares more Meta-focused options.


## Which agencies fit a Meta-heavy plan?


[Voy Media's creative studio page](https://voymedia.com/services/creative-studio/) lists full-service Facebook and Instagram ads with a creative studio, and its focus is direct response and customer acquisition in ecommerce, lead generation and mobile. Its[pricing page](https://voymedia.com/pricing/) says packages are based on total ad spend, optimizations and growth, and it publishes no figures.


[Common Thread Collective's Meta page](https://commonthreadco.com/pages/meta-ads-agency) is the most Meta-specific of this group. It frames media work around contribution margin and invites brands that spend $100K or more a month on Meta to talk, as of October 2026.[Chamber Media's homepage](https://www.chamber.media/) FAQ says to expect around $5K to $10K a month at minimum for creative, strategy and management, and that growth is difficult on less than $5K a month in media for local brands, or $15K for national brands.


## How do you replace Single Grain without breaking search?


If search carries most of your Single Grain spend, the replacement is a search and paid media agency first and a creative partner second. Ask each finalist to show the Google or Bing account structure it would inherit, the reporting it would produce in the first month, and who owns the conversion data.


If Meta video is the gap, run the two decisions separately. A Meta creative provider can replace the production that is holding up your ads, while the search account stays with its current owner until the replacement proves itself. Our[ad creative testing guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/ad-creative-testing) covers how to judge a new creative batch.


Tracking is the usual failure point during an agency switch. Meta describes the[Conversions API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/conversions-api) as a connection from your server, website platform, app or CRM to its systems, used to optimize targeting and measure outcomes. Before you move any account, write down who owns that connection and who fixes events when they stop arriving. Also record where access is granted, who holds the approved creative files, and how approvals will pass between the two teams.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for finished Meta video creative, with optional campaign management on a custom quote.
- Single Grain's page covers search, social and creative production, but publishes no minimum, pricing or video volume.
- For search and social together, Darkroom publishes a starting fee and KlientBoost lists $5,000 a month ad budgets, while MuteSix, Voy Media and Disruptive Advertising publish no full fees.
- Split search and Meta creative into separate decisions, and document who owns conversion tracking before any switch.


## FAQ


### What is the best Single Grain alternative for Meta ads?


Knowlify is our top pick if the gap is finished Meta video ads, with optional Meta campaign management on a custom quote. If you need Meta inside a broader multichannel plan, compare Darkroom, MuteSix and Voy Media, then confirm each fee and fit in writing. Name the channels you run before you choose, because few agencies cover every channel equally well.


### What are Single Grain alternatives for paid ads beyond Meta?


For search and social together, shortlist Darkroom, KlientBoost and Disruptive Advertising, which each list Google alongside Facebook. Their pages differ on pricing: Darkroom publishes a $1,500 monthly starting point, KlientBoost lists $5,000 a month ad budgets, and Disruptive Advertising publishes a "couple thousand dollars" tier. Ask each for a written scope per channel.


### Does Single Grain publish pricing?


Its paid advertising page does not list pricing, minimum spend or contract terms. Its contact form asks for a monthly marketing budget, with "Less than $3,000" as the lowest option, which is a qualifying question rather than a published minimum. Ask for a written scope and fee before you compare it with others.


### Can one agency cover search and Meta creative?


Some can, but confirm who produces the creative and who runs the search account. Single Grain's page lists creative production next to Google and Bing, so ask for a scope per channel. Knowlify does not run Google ads, so pair it with a search provider if you need both.


### What should I keep when switching paid ads agencies?


Keep account access, conversion tracking and every approved creative file. Confirm who owns the Conversions API setup and who fixes it when events stop arriving. Run a short overlap period before you end the old contract.
